description: Elsevier's elsarticle (CTAN, v3.5 of 2026/01/09, from MiKTeX 9766) in its single-column 3p format, the wide-measure final layout of Elsevier's single-column journals: A4 with a 468pt by 622pt text block, 18pt footskip and 10pt type (elsarticle.cls l.85, l.1266-1280); unlike 5p it neither turns two-column nor loads fleqn.clo (that happens only for 3p,twocolumn, l.1280). Its preamble is elsarticle-5p's and elsarticle-preprint's (batch 1, round 2): \title takes a paragraph (elsarticle.cls l.123-125 with \long; General's title ends its \parbox with \par, and elsarticle's \def\title stopped at 'Paragraph ended before \title was complete'), and where a way loads titlesec \paragraph gets elsarticle's own run-in format, since elsarticle defines it through \secdef (l.1069-1076) and titlesec gives such a command no format ('No format for this command').
